title: Polynomial-label cofactor geometry and the prime boundary
objective: Investigate a genuinely different bounded-label/cofactor mechanism for the original polynomial-rough Goldbach target, retaining nonzero centers and the prime boundary; prove one useful connection or a decisive failure of a precise candidate invariant.
deliverables: At most two exact cofactor/operator candidates
Proof or explicit counterexample at the first load-bearing claim
Correct nonzero centers and h=1 boundary
Separate semantic review and bounded falsification
A precise new analytic obligation rather than repeated parameter retuning
success_criteria: Local factor capacity is not assumed to bound all primes introduced along a path
Every comparison retains exact cofactors, support and prime boundary
No zero-centered conclusion or unproved polynomial-modulus root theorem is imported
Only a substantive independently checked arithmetic result may be called a breakthrough
stop_conditions: One bounded theorem round within20 proxy units
No paid inference, external mutable action or publication
A false invariant is recorded rather than repaired by weakening the Goldbach objective
